scope: Only frozen pipeline/node_exchange_store.py and tests/test_node_exchange_store.py; mutable simulator/tests/docs not read or reviewed.
mode: Read-only source review plus isolated synthetic filesystem/process/thread probes; no approving GitHub review.
verdict: Two concrete P2 store-boundary findings block closure of this exact frozen version.

findings.title: Recheck live root/ancestor/managed-directory guards after the final read/audit before success
findings.witness: After acquiring a session containing one registered blob, hook file_after_read. On occurrence 2 for read_blob/snapshot, or 3 for verified_absent([an absent UUID]), weaken root/allowed_root to 0755 or rename root and install another root inode.
findings.observed: Nine combinations succeed instead of generically holding. read_blob returns the private synthetic payload, snapshot returns metadata, and verified_absent returns True while the live designated root/ancestor privacy or inode binding is invalid.
findings.required: Revalidate the complete live root/ancestor/lock/managed-directory descriptor/name/permission binding at final read/audit and public return boundaries; retain generic cause-free errors.

findings.title: Fence thread/process reuse of an active session or serialize its methods
findings.witness: One thread uses a shared active session to put a blob and pauses at put_before_payload_write. Another thread uses that same session to snapshot; recovery removes the live stage and rolls back its reservation. Separately fork with a held session; the child calls commit_metadata through the inherited flock open-file-description.
findings.observed: The live put aborts because another thread erased its staged transaction. The forked child commits metadata without acquiring a new lock domain; its session and inherited flock were accepted.
findings.required: Pin creator PID and thread identity and reject foreign-session use before recovery/read/write, or provide equivalent per-session/process-safe serialization. Sessions acquired independently in separate threads/processes must still share the one root lock.

passing_controls: All 89 frozen author tests pass independently on the same source hash, including its real-process crash and guard-order coverage.
An internal callback throwing a private fictional message produces a fixed generic store error with no cause/context and releases resources so a later independently locked session succeeds.
Two threads acquiring their own sessions cannot enter simultaneously: the second enters only after the first root lock is released.
independent_probe_counts: 13 cases: 9 late root/ancestor/name guard failures, 1 active shared-thread transaction rollback failure, 1 inherited-fork mutation failure, 2 passing callback/thread-exclusion controls.
limitations: Only local macOS results are claimed; Linux CI/no-replace support and other platform behavior remain separate. Unsupported Windows is not readiness.
The store does not establish simulator authority, role quotas, alias restrictions, claim/reply policy or erasure coverage mapping; those mutable parent responsibilities remain outside this review.
No malicious-owner rollback-proof, distributed erasure, real sharing, scientific validation or production authority is established.
remaining: Author repair and exact new frozen hashes; independent failure witnesses and affinity-specific controls must run again before closure. This is not merge clearance.
